headline: OAK @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 3.88 at CHC 4.84, with a projected total of 8.71. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: OAK moved +0.31 runs while CHC moved +0.47, changing the projected margin by -0.16 runs. The projected total climbed +0.78, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jeffrey Springs has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Tyler Soderstrom, Alex Bregman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Lawrence Butler, Kevin Alcántara because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
